description.value: Hastings House is a member of Relais & Châteaux and occupies 22 acres of oceanfront property overlooking Ganges Harbour on Salt Spring Island, offering 18 individually styled suites and cottages. The estate includes an acclaimed farm-to-table Manor Dining restaurant and the cedar-clad Wellspring Spa, drawing on produce from onsite gardens. Its location is within easy walking distance of the village of Ganges, making it a comfortable base from which to explore Salt Spring Island by bike.
